body.name: Finite-unsupported-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{fin}}\) is the class of finite RSCMs over \(S\) and \(G\) that induce the source groundings \(Rsrc\) and target grounding \(\rho\) encoded by \(Ictx\), have mutually independent exogenous noises, have no exogenous relational parent and no non-relational exogenous parent shared by distinct ground endogenous variables, have type-shared finite mechanisms, reproduce \(Psrc\), use the recovered rows \(K\) at every target-relevant positive-source-support key, and leave precisely the target-relevant keys in \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{free}}\) unrestricted over their native finite outcome alphabets.
